name: Rei
overview: Rei is a male figure mentioned in the biblical account who played a supportive role during a critical political moment. He is noted specifically for backing David when Adonijah attempted to seize the throne. No tribal affiliation or additional personal details are recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Rei is a proper name meaning 'friendly' or '[my] friend.' This meaning reflects a positive character trait but was not given by God according to the biblical record.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record any family relationships for Rei beyond his individual actions noted in the historical account. No relatives or close associates are mentioned in the available data.
scriptureSignificance: Rei's significance lies in his allegiance to David during Adonijah's coup attempt, demonstrating loyalty at a pivotal moment in Israel's monarchy. His support contributed to the consolidation of David's kingship, highlighting the importance of faithful allies in God's providential plan. Although a minor figure, Rei's role exemplifies the faithful backing of God's chosen king amid political turmoil.
